description: Get a Korean court precedent: holdings (판시사항), summary (판결요지), referenced provisions (참조조문) and full text (판례내용). Precedents are not law: they are reference material, decisions on individual cases, and may change later. id is the number from search_case results (not the case number).

id.description: The first number (digits) of a search_case result. Not the case number (e.g. 2018다287034)

name: get_case
title: Get court precedent (판례 보기)
